story.value: The name tungsten comes from Swedish words meaning "heavy stone".
The symbol W comes from the German word wolfram.
Tungsten metal was first isolated in 1783 by the Spanish chemists Fausto Elhuyar and his brother Juan José.

uses.value: Tungsten is used to make filaments for incandescent light bulbs, fluorescent light bulbs and television tubes.
Tungsten is used as a target for producing X-rays.
Tungsten carbide, an extremely hard tungsten compound, is used in the tips of drill bits.
Compounds of tungsten with calcium and magnesium are used in fluorescent light bulbs.
